name: European Business Wallet Owner Identification Data
description: Identifies the owner of a European Business Wallet - an economic operator or public sector body - by the unique identifier and official name held by the authentic source that issued it.

display.name: Business Wallet Owner ID
display.description: Identifies the organisation that owns this European Business Wallet.

display.label: Organisation identifier
display.description: EUID where available, otherwise a similar constructed, unique per issuer identifier.

display.label: Attestation category
display.description: The legal category of the attestation.

display.label: Issuing authority
display.description: Name of the administrative authority, Commission (for Union entities), or QTSP issuing the EAA/QEAA; or ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 where applicable.

display.label: Organisation name
display.description: Official name of the EBW owner (economic operator or public sector body).

display.label: Issuing country
display.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the provider’s country/territory.

display.label: Trust anchor
display.description: URL at which a machine-readable version of the trust anchor to be used for verifying the EBW-OID can be found or looked up.
